Description: Drag-strip Velocita: AWD with 40 psi boost, 500 kW nitrous usable from 1st gear above 5000 rpm, 7500 rpm launch control, acceleration-tuned traction control, wing locked flat, short stacked gears, locked-up diffs and low rear tire pressure. Built for 0-60, quarter-mile and 0-200 runs; tops out around 225 mph.
